tips.text: Mine Heciphron with a Nosam Cutter, never the Sunpoint Plasma Drill; the drill's rare gems crowd out the Heciphron you want.
Do one short Sunpoint drill pass for the 3 Embolos, then switch to a Nosam Cutter for Heciphron.
Run Requiem Obelisks for gems; the Vitrific Outcrops around them also pay Lucent Teroglobe.
Trade spare Mother Tokens up to Grandmother Tokens whenever you pass through Deimos, so the shard is ready when the parts are.
Start banking Grandmother Tokens the day you start mining; the Seriglass Shard only shows once you own the parts blueprints.
Collect the Argon Crystal last and build the Receiver the same day; it halves every 24 hours.
Take the Trumna Blueprint as the free Rank 3 pick instead of paying 5,000 standing.
Rank Ostron to Trusted and buy the two Cetus refinement blueprints early; they are cheap and you will be in Cetus anyway.
Run the conservation leg solo; enemies and squadmates kill tranquilised targets and host migration eats resources.
Bring Ivara with Prowl to fish, mine, tranq and scan without breaking invisibility; strip your Oxylus's weapons so it does not kill targets.
Plan on 3 or more Forma before judging it; it ships with no polarities and a slow reload.
Almost nobody regrets building it; players call the grind bad and the gun worth it.
Reports range from 4 hours total to about a week; Heciphron and Grandmother Tokens cause nearly all of the variance.
